items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: You remember another cornet player, Bunk Johnson?

ctx.x: What? Freddy Kepard? I heard him before the storm. I heard him before the storm around 1914. I heard him. Yeah, I went to his dance. He was a little bit of a dance.
You remember another cornet player, Bunk Johnson? No. What's that called Bunk?
I know Blue, well I didn't know him good, but I've been behind his music. He's a fella who broke his gall string right down my way, one son behind a parade.
